init_running_statistics_state: initialize a RunningStatisticsState for a nested structure using init_state with specs.Array
update_running_statistics: update running statistics incrementally by calling update with batched JAX array data
normalize_with_running_stats: normalize data to zero mean and unit variance using normalize with a RunningStatisticsState
denormalize_data: denormalize previously normalized data back to original scale using denormalize with a RunningStatisticsState
clip_nested_batch: clip nested array values to a max absolute value using clip with NestClippingConfig
